rt:param.name: Grad_Style
rt:param.comment: Индикатор имеет градиентную заливку - объёмный фон

rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub BGColor () Dim BadQ As Boolean Dim res As Boolean res = False NoGrad = False
BadQ = false
If pv_1 != Nothing Then If !PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_1.PVId, False) Then If pv_1.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then BadQ = True Else res = (pv_1.Value != 0) End If End If Else body.fill = Color_ErLink NoGrad = True Exit Sub End If If pv_2 != Nothing Then If !PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_2.PVId, False) Then If pv_2.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then BadQ = true Else res = res && (pv_2.Value != 0) End If End If ElseIf PointID_2 != "NULL" Then BadQ = true End If If pv_3 != Nothing Then If !PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_3.PVId, False) Then If pv_3.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then BadQ = true Else res = res && (pv_3.Value != 0) End If End If ElseIf PointID_3 != "NULL" Then BadQ = true End If
If BadQ Then body.fill = Color_Inval NoGrad = True ElseIf res Then body.fill = Col_ON Else body.fill = Col_OFF End If End Sub

Sub CheckLocalGroup () In_Group = (PRJSPEC.GRP_In(PointID_1) > 0) If pv_2 != Nothing Then In_Group = In_Group || (PRJSPEC.GRP_In(PointID_2) > 0) End If If pv_3 != Nothing Then In_Group = In_Group || (PRJSPEC.GRP_In(PointID_3) > 0) End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
Dim Th_Ht As Float Dim Th_Wdth As Float Th_Ht = _This.height Th_Wdth = _This.width
Grad_BG.width = Th_Wdth Grad_BG.height = Th_Ht body.width = Th_Wdth body.height = Th_Ht RB_border.points = "0," + CStr(Th_Ht) + " " + CStr(Th_Wdth)+ "," + CStr(Th_Ht) + " " + CStr(Th_Wdth) + ",0" LU_border.points = "0," + CStr(Th_Ht) + " 0,0 " + CStr(Th_Wdth) + ",0" InGr.x = -2.5 InGr.y = -2.5 InGr.width = Th_Wdth + 5 InGr.height = Th_Ht + 5 I_Text.x = Th_Wdth / 2 I_Text.y = Th_Ht / 2 - 2.5 '2.5 - коррекция по высоте для мелких размеров My_Text.width = 50 My_Text.height = 25 My_Text.x = (_This.width - 50.0) / 2.0 My_Text.y = (_This.height - 25.0) / 2.0 SelArea.width = Th_Wdth SelArea.height = Th_Ht

I_Text.visibility = "hidden" My_Text.visibility = "visible" If (PointID_1 != "NULL") then pv_1 = BIN(PointID_1) Else body.fill = Color_ErLink End If If (PointID_2 != "NULL") then pv_2 = BIN(PointID_2) End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") then pv_3 = BIN(PointID_3) End If

Вход 1 = "" + PointID_1 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_2 != "NULL") && (pv_2 == nothing)) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 2 = "" + PointID_2 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_3 != "NULL") && (pv_3 == nothing)) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 3 = "" + PointID_3 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_2 == "NULL") && (PointID_3 == "NULL")) Then Call_Win("wi_BIN", PointID_1) Else Dim s As String s = PointID_1 If (PointID_2 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_2 End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_3 End If Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", s) End If

Dim MsgStr As String If PointID_1 == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_1 == nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
